title: Canonical carbon-intensity types
description: Internal types for Carbon Data Service: Zone, Timestamp, CarbonIntensity, ForecastArray, CarbonRecord. Units are always gCO2e/kWh.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: Logical energy zone. Must match Kubernetes label carbon-aware.io/zone (DNS-1123 label). Not a cloud region.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: UTC instant, RFC 3339. Interval start is left-closed: value at T covers [T, T+interval).

unit.description: Canonical unit. gCO2eq/kWh (Electricity Maps) is an alias of gCO2e/kWh. NESO gCO2/kWh is mapped with emission_factor_type=direct and a provenance note; no numeric conversion factor is applied.

carbonIntensity.title: CarbonIntensity
carbonIntensity.description: Grid carbon intensity in gCO2e/kWh. Negative, NaN and +Inf are invalid (DOD-TEST-04).

emissionFactorType.description: lifecycle = cradle-to-grave (Electricity Maps default). direct = operational stack emissions only (closer to NESO generation-only).

temporalGranularity.description: Width of each observation interval. 5_minutes and 60_minutes are the diploma baselines; 30_minutes exists for NESO ingest.

horizonSeconds.description: timestamp - issuedAt, in seconds. Replay Engine may recompute from timestamps.

forecastArray.title: ForecastArray
forecastArray.description: Ordered by timestamp ascending, unique timestamps. Horizon typically 1–24 h. Empty array means persistence model CI(t+Δ)=CI(t) (SCOPE-EDGE-03).

sourceZone.description: Provider-native zone key (e.g. DK-DK2, GB). Optional after mapping to logical Zone.

flowTraced.description: true = consumption-based (Electricity Maps default). false = production-based.
